fullPassage: A recent study by Bernheim, Garrett, and Maki suggests that the teaching of self-controlling techniques is important. Bernheim, Garrett, Maki They studied the influence on asset accumulation in adulthood of taking courses in household financial decision making in high school. These courses covered topics such as budgeting, credit management, balancing checkbooks, and compound interest. Some states never adopted these consumer educational programs, while others adopted them at different times, making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over time The researchers found that asset accumulation was higher in the states that had adopted these educational programs than in those that did not Moreover those who as children had been encouraged to save using a bank account saved more than others as adults. Similarly those who characterized their parents as having saved more than average saved more than others.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오.

A recent study suggests that the __________ (teach) of self-controlling techniques is important.

det.korean: teach(동사) → teaching(명사): the teaching of — 관사+명사 구조.
det.analysis: the + 명사 구조이므로 동사 teach를 명사/동명사 teaching으로 변환.
det.tip: the teaching of = ~의 가르침/교육

questions.passage: A recent study by Bernheim, Garrett, and Maki suggests that the teaching of self-controlling techniques is important. Bernheim, Garrett, Maki They studied the influence on asset accumulation in adulthood of taking courses in household financial decision making in high school. These courses covered topics such as budgeting, credit management, balancing checkbooks, and compound interest. Some states never adopted these consumer educational programs, while others adopted them at different times, __________. The researchers found that asset accumulation was higher in the states that had adopted these educational programs than in those that did not Moreover those who as children had been encouraged to save using a bank account saved more than others as adults. Similarly those who characterized their parents as having saved more than average saved more than others.
questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (11단어)

[조건] making, it, possible, to, compare, subsequent, saving, across, states, and, over를 모두 사용하여 문장을 완성하시오. (영어로)
questions.wa: making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over
accept: making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over
Making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over
making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over.

det.korean: making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over (주간·시간에 걸쳐 이후 저축을 비교하는 것을 가능하게 하며)
det.analysis: 분사구문 making + it(가목적어) + possible(보어) + to compare(진목적어).
det.tip: make it possible to V = ~하는 것을 가능하게 하다 (가목적어 it)

questions.passage: A recent study by Bernheim, Garrett, and Maki suggests that the teaching of self-controlling techniques is important. Bernheim, Garrett, Maki They studied the influence on asset accumulation in adulthood of taking courses in household financial decision making in high school. These courses covered topics such as budgeting, credit management, balancing checkbooks, and compound interest. Some states never adopted these consumer educational programs, while others adopted them at different times, making it possible to compare subsequent saving across states and over time The researchers found that asset accumulation was higher in the states that had adopted these educational programs than in those that did not Moreover those who as children had been encouraged to save using a bank account saved more than others as adults. Similarly those who characterized their parents as having saved more than average saved more than others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 고등학교 재정 교육이 성인기 저축과 자산 축적에 미치는 긍정적 영향
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 고등학교 재정 교육이 성인기 저축과 자산 축적에 미치는 긍정적 영향: 글 전체 주제.
❌ ① 복리 이자의 수학적 원리: 세부 주제에 불과.
❌ ② 미국 주별 교육 정책의 차이점: 비교 방법론이지 주제가 아님.
❌ ④ 부모와 자녀 간 세대 갈등: 본문에 갈등 언급 없음.
det.tip: 주제 = 재정 교육 → 자산 축적 효과

ch: 복리 이자와 수표 관리의 수학적 원리와 실용적 활용 방법
미국 각 주별 소비자 교육 프로그램 정책의 채택 시기와 차이점

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요약문으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 고등학교 재정 교육과 어린 시절 저축 격려가 성인기 자산 축적을 높인다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 고등학교 재정 교육과 어린 시절 저축 격려가 성인기 자산 축적을 높인다: 글 전체 요약과 일치.
❌ ② 모든 주가 재정 교육을 시행하고 있다: some states never adopted라고 함.
❌ ③ 부모의 저축 습관은 자녀의 저축과 무관하다: 부모 저축이 자녀에게 영향.
❌ ④ 복리 이자가 자산 축적의 유일한 요인이다: 유일한 요인이 아님.
det.tip: 요약 = 재정 교육 + 저축 격려 → 성인기 자산 축적 증가

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸을 채워 문장을 완성하시오. (2단어)

"이 과정은 예산 편성, 신용 관리, 수표책 맞추기, 그리고 __________ 등의 주제를 다루었다."

[조건] (1) compound, interest를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 2단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: compound interest (복리 이자): 과정이 다루는 주제 중 하나입니다.
det.analysis: budgeting, credit management, balancing checkbooks, and compound interest로 나열.
det.tip: compound interest = 복리 (이자), simple interest = 단리
